aboutSubheading: Local expertise with a fresh approach
aboutText: Inhabitate Landscape + Design is Brunswick's go-to landscape design firm, recently merged with Small Spaces Garden Design to enhance our services. With a focus on innovative outdoor spaces, we cater to both residential and commercial clients across Melbourne. Our team, led by James Thomson, brings creativity and practicality to every project, ensuring your garden thrives in Brunswick's unique climate.
servicesText: We offer comprehensive landscape design services, from initial concept to final installation. Specialising in garden makeovers, sustainable designs, and outdoor living areas, we transform Brunswick backyards into functional retreats.

services.title: Garden Design
services.desc: Tailored designs that reflect your style and Brunswick's local flora, creating harmonious outdoor environments.

services.title: Landscaping
services.desc: Full landscaping services including earthworks, planting, and feature installation for complete garden transformations.

services.title: Outdoor Living Areas
services.desc: Design and build of decks, patios, and entertainment spaces perfect for Melbourne's indoor-outdoor lifestyle.

services.title: Planting & Greenery
services.desc: Expert selection and placement of plants suited to Brunswick's climate, ensuring year-round beauty.

services.title: Hardscaping
services.desc: Installation of paths, walls, and other structural elements to define and enhance your garden space.

services.title: Maintenance Plans
services.desc: Ongoing care programs to keep your landscape looking its best with minimal effort on your part.
